title: Toolkit name field empty in 'jentic access whoami' output
description: The 'jentic access whoami' command returns toolkit bindings with an empty 'name' field, making it unclear which API each toolkit serves without additional lookups.
reproduction_steps: Request and receive access to a toolkit
Observe the toolkit binding has an empty 'name' field
expected_behavior: The toolkit binding should include a descriptive name field indicating which API or service the toolkit provides access to (e.g., 'jentic-test/test-api/1.0.0' or 'Test API Toolkit')
actual_behavior: The toolkit binding shows 'name: ""' (empty string), requiring users to cross-reference the toolkit ID elsewhere to determine what it provides access to
evidence: [AX] task=verify-access-granted | Toolkit name field empty in whoami output - agent noted unclear which API each toolkit serves
Agent narration: 'However, the toolkit doesn't show which API it's for in this output.'
